qemu: fix bug in registration logic The code to check existing binfmt registration looks for the incorrect interpreter name. We look for the direct qemu name "qemu-arm" when we actually register the wrapper "qemu-arm-binfmt-wrapper". This caused the code to always re-register the format on every invocation. The for loop also walked characters instead of lines, so even if we had the correct path, we'd never have matched properly. This should help with the race where two processes both unregister the handler. When the first one unregisters, the file disappears, so when the next one tries to unregister (and the first one hasn't reregistered) yet, we try to create a file in the directory which the kernel rejects.
